subject: SCI AND TECH
bill.title: Requires artificial intelligence companion operators to provide notifications that users are not communicating with human.

action.description: Reported and Referred to Assembly Appropriations Committee

posted_text:
🧠 AI, Data Centers & Crypto
NJ A4732 — AI Companions Must Warn You It's Not a Person

New Jersey is considering a law that would require operators of artificial intelligence companion models – those systems designed to mimic human relationships – to clearly tell users they’re talking to a machine. The AI must provide this warning at the start of each interaction and repeat it every three hours. If an operator fails to do so, they could face a $15,000 civil penalty. ...
